name: intergraph
description: Autonomous self-tuning ecosystem graph for Sylveste. SQLite store + MCP query server over declared structure (manifests, skills, hooks, MCP configs, cross-plugin references). Phase 2 adds observed-behavior edge weights from cass session histories; phase 3 adds tldrs code edges. interchart renders its export.
author: mistakeknot
